title: Goh Joo Hin - The GJH Story Manga
designStyle: A six-chapter black-and-white manga reader with screentone panels, tap-to-reveal speech bubbles, a red crescent accent and a fact-check drawer for every chapter.
disclaimer: Independent design concept, not affiliated with Goh Joo Hin.
summary: Read the Goh Joo Hin story as a six-chapter manga. Tap panels to reveal dialogue, then open each chapter's fact check and sources.
